name: backend-dev
description: Team kit for APIs on Cloudflare Workers + Firestore (Hono, Effect, Firebase auth, vitest), on an existing repo or monorepo or a new one from its template. /backend-dev:kit-setup writes the repo's project profile, /backend-dev:ticket works a GitLab ticket through the stages it needs, onboard maps the repo for newcomers, and eight stage skills cover system-design, data-model, api-contract, implement, review-and-secure, live-verify, delivery and incident.
